sloka: भरतो ऽपि तथैवोष्य संवत्सरमतो ऽधिकम् ।अयोध्यां पुनरागम्य रामपादावुपास्त सः ।। ७.१०२.१४ ॥
transliteration: bharato 'pi tathaivoṣya saṁvatsaramato 'dhikam ।ayodhyāṁ punarāgamya rāmapādāvupāsta saḥ ।। 7.102.14 ॥

translations.english: Bharata also, having similarly resided for more than a year, returned to Ayodhya and worshipped Rama's feet.
